text: q Fixed costs + Desired profit Target unit sales volume = ——— ———— =~ —— Unit contribution margin Assume that Razor’s management desires to know the unit sales volume required to achieve a monthly profit of $75,000. Using the profit formula, the required unit sales volume is determined by setting profit equal to $75,000 and solving for X, the required unit sales volume. Profit = Total revenues — Total costs $75,000 = $60X - ($50,000 + $38X) Solving for X $60X - $38X = $50,000 + $75.000 X = ($50,000 + $75.000) + $22 = 5,682 units (rounded)
